description: This file defines an Error Boundary React component for handling errors gracefully in a UI, including fallback UI, error logging, and specialized MCP error handling.

classes.name: ErrorBoundary
classes.description: A React component implementing an error boundary with fallback UI, error logging, and reset capabilities.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromError
methods.description: Static method to update state when an error is caught, triggering fallback UI.

methods.name: componentDidCatch
methods.description: Lifecycle method to log error details and set error state.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to reset error state on specific prop changes.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to clear any pending reset timeout.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets error state to initial values, clearing timers.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders fallback UI when an error has occurred, otherwise renders children.
